title: Webinar: the evolution of MIMO technology for 5G and beyond
excerpt: Dr. Nadisanka Rupasinghe of Samsung Research America on how MIMO shaped 5G — and where it goes next.
content:
An insightful session on the “Evolution of MIMO Technology for 5G and Beyond” with Dr. Nadisanka Rupasinghe, a Research Engineer at Samsung Research America, held via Zoom.

The webinar was accompanied by a daily 5G fact series on the chapter’s social channels.
